description: Réseau d'eaux pluviales - collecte is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by GRAND ANNECY Agglomération. Stormwater system in the territory of the Grand Annecy, These data identify and geolocalise water networks and structures, regardless of their status (public/private) and their manager (Grand Annecy, Communes, Department, private owners, etc.). Coverage: GRAND ANNECY Agglomération. The portal shows the English title as "Stormwater system — collection" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is GRAND ANNECY Agglomération. Its keywords include conduites, avaloir, regard, pluviale, reseau, annecy. The listing shows 6 download or service links in JSON. The listing shows 2024-11-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
